annotation.summary: The analysis highlights the robust group differences in depression, anxiety, and PTSD using facial-expression analysis and attention-bias tasks. However, these methods are typically implemented as single-modality or standalone cognitive apps rather than integrated assessments. Multimodal systems combining speech, text, facial, and behavioral features have achieved ROC-AUC values around 0.85-0.90 in controlled studies. Several digital therapeutics and behavioural biomarkers have obtained FDA or CE authorizations for regulatory openness to digital endpoints. However, validated pipelines are primarily English-language and Western-centric, with few tailored to Ukrainian or war-affected populations. Performance sensitivity is high due to microphones, webcams, and lighting outside curated settings; many studies fuse a small number of streams post hoc on limited datasets; and high-performing models often lack transparency and bias control.

candidate_qas.answer: Recent nationally representative data show that over one-third of Ukrainian adults meet criteria for at least one mental-health disorder, yet only tens of thousands receive a formal diagnosis each year.
